summary: John the Baptist prepared the way of the Lord and called the people to repentance. His courageous witness and humble service make him a constant sign of conversion.
antiphon_text: Let us remember Saint John the Baptist as a faithful witness to the love and mercy of Christ.
prayer_text: Lord God, through the life of Saint John the Baptist, strengthen us to follow your path with courage and charity. Grant us the grace to bear faithful witness in our own time. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
